full_judgment: Mr. Selim , the learned Deputy Attorney General appearing for the State, in appreciation of his submission, has cited some decisions in the cases of Hazrat Ali Vs. The State reported in 11 B.L.D.(AD)270, Abdul Hye Sikder Vs. The State, reported in 12 B.L.D. (AD) 180, Mistha Vs. The State, reported in (1963) P.L.D. (Karachi) (DB) 1, Ghulam Vs. The Crown 1950 P.L.D. (Lahore) 90, Baktiar Hossain Vs. The State reported in 47 D.L.R. (HCD) 542 but those decisions do not apply in the present case as the facts and circumstances of those cases are distinguishable from that of the present case.
